naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2→1: selected metadata/status say converged at step627 (3.004 residual orders), but last 62 raw force rows Cd falls monotonically 0.2440661→0.1938463 (20.6%), with first/second half means 0.2296330→0.2042443; no stable force plateau. TASK.md:140,172 require clear early convergence or stable justified plateau. Metadata git_revision=null; final source stop logic is not assumed to have produced the run. Post-processing floor remains independently deficient; no CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 5→2: report_data.tex:19 gives Cd1.997, Cl−0.001196 and selected raw late Cd 1.99656–1.99838 supports a plausible stable result; residual plot is readable. Visually reviewed accepted PDF p10 and immutable force image: startup Cd≈103 compresses the late force tail. Its pressure/Mach panels collapse to a thin domain strip, not a wake-revealing contour; standalone vorticity image has the same strip and no other delivered wake plot found. Post-processing floor is unmet. Production metadata git_revision=null; no CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained: report_data.tex:20 gives post-transient mean Cd0.9727 and mean Cl0.001315±0.01511, correcting prior mistaken citation of residual-statistics line32; :42 gives St0.14. Selected raw force FFT peak 0.14 for t>=100,150,200; Cl range -0.03642–0.03765 for t>=150. PDF p10/committed force figure is dominated by startup Cd≈30 and shows no readable late lift AND drag oscillations; wake zoom on p11 is readable. Metadata git_revision=null and fully refreshed-limiter strict miss count is unknown. No unsteady rerun.

The report explicitly discloses plateau criteria; residual-order shortfalls alone do not prove false success.
